# adapters/claude-code/config/g2-grandfather-slugs.txt
# G2 grandfather population (gated-pipeline-master-2026-08 Task 17, REQ-B8,
# design docs/designs/gated-pipeline-master-2026-08-03.md Section 4
# "Grandfather (C-2)").
#
# One OPAQUE entry per line: sha256 hex of the plan slug (the basename of
# docs/plans/<slug>.md minus the .md extension) -- "the slug list IS the
# mechanism" (design SS4). Entries are hashed, not plaintext, because the
# machine-wide population spans other repos' plans and plaintext slugs
# would ship product/identity strings in the harness repo (constitution
# S9 / harness-hygiene denylist; converted at the T17 merge train,
# 2026-08-03). Membership test: printf '%s' "<slug>" | sha256sum.
# REQ-C2 drain removes an entry by hashing the retired slug the same way. A
# plan-phase-builder/test-writer dispatch against a CHAIN-LESS plan whose
# slug is LISTED here proceeds with a LEDGERED WARN naming the retrofit
# path (dispatch plan-fidelity-reviewer, add a ## Review Chain block); an
# UNLISTED slug BLOCKS. Per the F-4 gate-ordering rule this list is
# consulted ONLY when no chain parses at all -- a plan with an earned
# valid (or merely invalid-but-present) chain never reaches this file.
# New plans never earn a place on this list, only what existed the moment
# G2 went live does (design C-2): this population shrinks via REQ-C2's
# estate drain, it never grows.
#
# Generated ONCE at G2's install (this commit IS that install, per the
# design's own framing -- REQ-B8/Task 17), from every extant plan slug at
# generation time: top-level `docs/plans/*.md` PLUS top-level
# `docs/plans/archive/*.md` ("archive slugs" per the task text). Neither
# glob recurses into subdirectories (evidence-companion dirs under
# docs/plans/, nested archive dirs) -- consistent with the shallow
# docs/plans/<slug>.md resolution _dcg_extract_plan_slug/rc_chain_entries
# already use everywhere else in this pipeline. The `<slug>-evidence.md`
# convention is included too (harmless over-inclusion -- one extra WARN
# row, never a block, and REQ-C2's drain retires it along with everything
# else here).
#
# Regenerate with (from the repo root; OVERWRITES the whole file, so
# re-add this header block afterward). T17 remedy R3 (2026-08-04): this
# command previously emitted PLAINTEXT slug basenames with no hashing step
# at all -- following it as written would both break _dcg_grandfathered's
# hash-match lookup (fail-closed: every legacy plan would BLOCK instead of
# WARN) and re-introduce the exact plaintext-product-string-in-the-harness
# shape S9's conversion (2026-08-03) removed. Every slug is now piped
# through sha256sum, matching the header's own membership-test line above:
#   { for f in docs/plans/*.md; do basename "$f" .md; done; \
#     for f in docs/plans/archive/*.md; do basename "$f" .md; done; } \
#     | sort -u \
#     | while read -r s; do printf '%s' "$s" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1; done \
#     > adapters/claude-code/config/g2-grandfather-slugs.txt
#
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored by the gate's reader
# (_dcg_grandfathered in hooks/dispatch-chain-gate.sh).
